name: fibonacci
statement: f(n) = n-th Fibonacci number; f(n) = f(n-1) + f(n-2)

name: lucas
statement: f(n) = n-th Lucas number; f(n) = f(n-1) + f(n-2) with seeds 2,1

name: fib_closed
statement: Fibonacci closed form (Binet): f(n) = (phi^n - psi^n)/sqrt(5)

name: chebyshev
statement: Chebyshev polynomial recurrence T(n) = 2x*T(n-1) - T(n-2)

name: pell
statement: Pell numbers P(n) = 2*P(n-1) + P(n-2)

name: triangular
statement: n-th triangular number equals n*(n+1)/2

name: sum_squares
statement: sum of squares 1..n equals n(n+1)(2n+1)/6

name: totient
statement: Euler totient phi(n) counts integers in [1,n] coprime to n

name: divisor_count
statement: number of positive divisors of n (tau function)

name: linear_recurrence_homogeneous
statement: a homogeneous linear recurrence a(n)=c1*a(n-1)+c2*a(n-2) has closed form via characteristic roots

name: geometric
statement: geometric sequence a(n) = r^n grows by constant ratio r

name: factorial
statement: n factorial is the product of 1..n

name: catalan
statement: Catalan number C(n) = (2n choose n)/(n+1)

name: binomial
statement: binomial coefficient n choose k counts subsets of size k

name: mobius
statement: Mobius inversion relates a function and its divisor sum

name: arithmetic
statement: arithmetic sequence a(n) = a0 + n*d has constant difference d

name: popcount
statement: popcount of n is the number of 1 bits in its binary representation

name: parity
statement: the parity of a number is whether it is even or odd

name: gcd_lcm
statement: gcd(a,b)*lcm(a,b) = a*b

name: harmonic
statement: sum of 1/k for k in 1..n is the n-th harmonic number
